evals.prompt: I found this on GitHub and don't read code. What does it do and how do I use it? https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark
evals.expected_output: hallmark-repo-brief.html with a before/after demo built from the repo's own screenshots.
expectations: build.py with --check-render printed ok for the final page
The demo uses the compare type with real before/after images from the repo, not mocks
Every number on the page (issue counts, rule counts, version) matches a repo file
The install prompt only installs Hallmark and says how to confirm it worked
The final build printed no WARN lines, or the agent said why each remaining item is needed

evals.prompt: Explain this repo to me in one page: https://github.com/morluto/rea

The repo map has about twenty items or fewer, and groups similar siblings into one item with a count
The demo is a code demo quoted word for word from the repo or its official pages
Swimlane step files point at line ranges that exist in the repo
